items.name: inputcn-base
items.title: inputcn base styles
items.description: Token-driven stylesheet for every inputcn component. Reads your shadcn CSS variables; hardcodes no colour or radius. Import once.

items.name: phone-input
items.title: Phone Input
items.description: Phone number field with a searchable country selector, live per-country formatting and E.164 output. Smart paste detects the country and offers an undo.

items.name: currency-input
items.title: Currency Input
items.description: Money field emitting integer minor units, so no float ever touches a price. Locale-correct formatting, zero-decimal currencies, three layouts.

items.name: masked-input
items.title: Masked Input
items.description: Template-masked text field with true caret preservation. Emits the raw value, never the formatted string. Twelve presets included.

items.name: percent-input
items.title: Percent Input
items.description: Percentage field that displays 12.5 and emits 0.125. The off-by-100 bug, solved once.

items.name: card-input
items.title: Credit Card Input
items.description: Card number, expiry and CVC with live brand detection, Luhn validation, brand-aware grouping and focus advancement.

items.name: duration-input
items.title: Duration Input
items.description: Duration field accepting 2h 30m, 90m or 1:30 and emitting seconds. Text, segmented and preset layouts.

items.name: color-input
items.title: Colour Input
items.description: Colour field with a swatch palette, format conversion and live WCAG contrast checking against a reference colour.

items.name: cron-input
items.title: Cron Input
items.description: Cron schedule field with a plain-English preview, upcoming run times, a visual builder and a minInterval guard.

items.name: filesize-input
items.title: File Size Input
items.description: File size field that keeps MB and MiB distinct and emits bytes.

items.name: ip-input
items.title: IP / CIDR Input
items.description: IPv4 and CIDR field with range computation, address classification and prefix bounds.

items.name: mention-input
items.title: Mention Input
items.description: Comment field with an @-triggered picker. Emits text plus the ids actually mentioned, recomputed on every edit.
